name: Voxel Placement in Octree
aliases: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) insertion with collapse/expand
definition: A recursive function to activate or deactivate a voxel at a specific 3D position within the octree.
summary: Voxel Placement in Octree is the recursive operation inserting colored voxils into a Sparse Voxel Octree, distinctively handling node expansion from collapsed states unlike broader growth or linearization methods.
